**Downlink G-PDUs carry the PDU Session Container**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | GTPv1-U / GTP-U Extension Header / PDU Session Container |
| Tags | none |
| Verdict class | FAIL |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 15s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | main |
| Needs | NG Setup, registration, PDU session establishment |

## Clauses

- TS 29.281 5.2.2.7 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: the clause is introduced in V15.2.0 as "may be transmitted"; "shall be transmitted" from V15.5.0; Rel-17: from V17.3.0 a bulleted list, adding N3mb/N19mb and End Marker bullets; the shall for G-PDUs over N3 and N9 is the same; Rel-19: from V19.1.0 "between NG-RAN and UPF" reads "between 5G-AN and UPF")
- TS 38.415 5.4.1.1 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 writes "DL PDU Session Information frame"; "DL PDU SESSION INFORMATION" by V15.3.0 (editorial); the wording is otherwise unchanged Rel-15 through Rel-19)
- TS 38.415 5.5.2.1 (Rel-15 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/N3-DL-QFI-CONTAINER.md).
